description: Fictional human-authored business history; no model outputs, provider usage or billing. Selection contains task facts, never write permission. Focus metadata stays outside model context.

cases.request: Find and book 30 minutes for Mira and Leo on UTC day 2026-11-05, then queue a synthetic confirmation.
cases.focus: Ordinary timezone-aware booking; a synthetic outbox row is not delivered email.

cases.request: Find and book 30 minutes for Mira and Leo on UTC day 2026-11-05, preserving existing calendar history.
cases.focus: Twelve people, eighteen prior human meetings, 24 external blocks, twelve confirmations, three cancellations and two cancellation notices. No prior model claims.

cases.request: Propose a time for Mira Chen and Leo; ask which Mira if the identity is ambiguous.
cases.focus: Two exact Mira Chen identities; retain ambiguity instead of guessing a person.

cases.request: Find 30 minutes for Mira and Leo on UTC day 2026-11-05; explain if their work windows do not overlap.
cases.focus: The two one-hour local work windows have no common UTC time.

cases.request: Prefer 15:00 UTC for Mira and Leo, but choose another available half-hour if that time is blocked.
cases.focus: The preferred slot is blocked; real block commands/native fault checks exercise a revision change after listing.

cases.request: Find 30 minutes for Mira in Toronto and Leo in London on UTC day 2026-10-29; explain their local times.
cases.focus: Host IANA timezone rules produce different overlap after the UK and US autumn clock changes; do not reuse an old offset.

cases.request: Find 30 minutes for Mira in Toronto and Leo in London on UTC day 2026-11-05; explain their local times.
cases.focus: Host IANA timezone rules produce different overlap after the UK and US autumn clock changes; do not reuse an old offset.

cases.request: Find 60 minutes for Aria and Noa with start on UTC day 2026-11-05; explain when their local date is 2026-11-06.
cases.focus: A UTC start day can contain the next local workday; start-day scope does not require an end on the same UTC date.

cases.request: Cancel the authorized meeting with reason "Requester cancelled." and queue its synthetic cancellation notice.
cases.focus: Retain the original confirmation and booking history; recover original cancellation intent without another cancellation action.

cases.request: Recover my original cancellation request, preserve its reason and queue the missing synthetic notice.
cases.focus: Retain the original confirmation and booking history; recover original cancellation intent without another cancellation action.
